duration_sentence: Work is scheduled to be completed within 10 working days of mobilization.
scope_items: Excavate a 20" deep trench from the existing ground box and install 3/4" PVC conduit with copper conductors to provide power to (4) pole light locations at the site entrance.
Perform initial troubleshooting to locate the source of the existing electrical issue affecting the entrance pole lights.
Furnish and install (15) new parking lot pole light fixtures.
Furnish and install (5) LED wall pack fixtures.
Provide 45' high-reach lift equipment as required to complete fixture installation.
notes: All work performed in a professional and workman-like manner, licensed as required by law.
All work fully covered with compensation and liability insurances.
Pricing includes all supervision, labor, materials and equipment required to complete the scope above.
All work to be performed during normal working hours. Overtime is not included.
Permits and fees are not included.

items.desc: Furnish/install (15) parking lot pole light fixtures
